name: Kagura
description: A point-light dancer: fifteen warm-white points on near-black at the joints of one human body, each dragging a 0.4 s amber trail, dancing in place. Five dances from CMU motion capture (twist, cabbage patch, chicken dance, macarena, Egyptian walk) are time-warped onto the cached beat grid, so each dance's pulse lands on a beat. The song's arousal and tempo pick three of them at track start; at each bar-line clip change the bass energy of the bar just played, ranked within the song, picks the calm, middle or vigorous one. The smoothed bass also swells and settles the arms by up to 25 percent. The figure sways, unwarped and never frozen, with no grid, on the streaming path until the beat tracker locks, while the grid's beat spacing is uneven, through silence, and when playback stops. Nothing brightens on the beat: the beat moves the pose. KAG.3, uncertified. See docs/presets/KAGURA_DESIGN.md.
author: Matt
